_about: Everything Story Lab Setup fetches, where from, how it is checked, and its licence. Sources verified 2026-10-17 (music: 2026-10-18) (installer/probe_sources.py: CivitAI by-hash + model API, Hugging Face tree API, GitHub release digests). sha256 is checked after every download; size_bytes drives the disk check and progress bars.
